title: 3 Hours, 0 Manual Modeling: How I built a 3D Mech Battle Game using GPT-5.5 and Tripo API.
author: outdahooud
selftext:
Here is the loop we ended up building using Codex, GPT-5.5, and the Tripo API:

The Core: GPT-5.5 writes the base arena code (mech movement, dash mechanics, projectile physics).

Scene Parsing: We wrote a script that scans the scene and detects every basic 3D placeholder.

Batch Generation: The script fires off prompts to the Tripo API to mass-create the actual assets we need—heavy mechs, weapon pods, and arena barricades.

Fetch & Export: It pulls everything back down as .GLB files.

Auto-Swap: The script automatically rips out the basic capsules/boxes and drops the real 3D mech assets into their exact positions.

The result: The exact same combat logic, but a fully populated mech arena generated almost instantly.
